short: verb modules and shared exit codes
is: One module per verb that runs the app use case, prints terse, --json or --more output, and maps the outcome to the shared exit codes.
conventions: One file per verb named after it; a verb module owns printing and the exit code, the logic stays in app
Exit codes for every verb: 0 ok, 1 domain refusal, 2 backend failure or missing, 64 listed but not built; clap keeps 2 for usage errors
Instance verbs read ZAF_INSTANCE (`<role> instance <n> on #<epic>`) and slice verbs ZAF_VERSION; the spawner sets both

fs.name: ask.rs
fs.role: ask and print the verified answer; exit 2 when a citation fails its check

fs.name: brief.rs
fs.role: write the pack, print path and token estimate

fs.name: check.rs
fs.role: check and verify; stores records under .zaf/runs/

fs.name: exit.rs
fs.role: exit codes, port and composition error mapping

fs.name: slice.rs
fs.role: slice actions plus helpers changes shares

fs.name: spawn.rs
fs.role: one tick, launches joined in parallel threads; --dry-run

notes: Verbs: board (ready, claim, report, question, ruling), ask, brief, check, verify, changes, slice (open, pr, merge, drop), spawn, asklog, status, report, guard, init, doctor, setup, profile init
